prologue_01.speaker: narrator
prologue_01.text: You wake slowly. Not all at once -- in pieces. First the weight of your body. Then the sound of wind through leaves.

prologue_02.speaker: narrator
prologue_02.text: There is grass beneath your palms. Soft earth. Somewhere nearby, water moves over stones.

prologue_03.speaker: narrator
prologue_03.text: Your chest is tight. An old tightness, the kind you've carried so long it feels like part of your ribs. But here, for a moment, it loosens.

prologue_04.speaker: narrator
prologue_04.text: In your hand -- warm, impossibly warm -- a deck of cards. They pulse like a second heartbeat.

prologue_05.speaker: narrator
prologue_05.text: You know your name. You just haven't said it out loud in a while. The cards are waiting for you to remember how.

oracle_ch1_01.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_01.text: The garden leads to a stone building covered in ivy. The door is open. Inside, soft light and the smell of herbs.

oracle_ch1_02.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_02.text: Someone is already inside, sitting at a table covered in cards, crystals, and dried flowers. They look up when you enter.

oracle_ch1_03.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_03.text: Oh. There you are. I had a feeling someone was coming today. The chamomile brewed itself twice this morning.

oracle_ch1_04.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_04.text: Please, sit. You look like you've been carrying a lot. You don't have to put it down all at once -- just set one piece on the table.

oracle_ch1_choice_01.text: How do you want to respond?

choices.text: I don't know where I am.
How did you know I was coming?

oracle_ch1_lost_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_lost_01.text: Somewhere safe. That's the short answer, and it's the true one.

oracle_ch1_lost_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_lost_02.text: This is a sanctuary. People find it when they need to. I don't make the rules -- the garden does.

oracle_ch1_curious_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_curious_01.text: The cards told me. Not in words -- more like a feeling. Like when you know it's going to rain before the sky changes.

oracle_ch1_curious_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_curious_02.text: I've learned to trust those feelings. They've never steered me wrong about people.

oracle_ch1_tired_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_tired_01.text: {oracle} pauses. Looks at you -- really looks. Not through you, not past you. At you.

oracle_ch1_tired_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_tired_02.text: I know. I can see it. That kind of tired that sleep doesn't fix.

oracle_ch1_tired_03.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_tired_03.text: You don't have to explain it. Not today. Today you just need to be here.

oracle_ch1_skill_unlock_01.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_skill_unlock_01.text:
[Skill Unlocked: Grounding]
When everything feels overwhelming, bring your attention to five things you can see, four you can touch, three you can hear, two you can smell, one you can taste. You are here. You are present.

oracle_ch1_quiet_01.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_quiet_01.text: You say nothing. You sit. The chair is sturdy and worn -- it has held many people before you.

oracle_ch1_quiet_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_quiet_02.text: {oracle} smiles. Not a big smile -- just enough. They slide a cup of tea toward you without being asked.

oracle_ch1_quiet_03.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_quiet_03.text: Sometimes the bravest thing is just being somewhere. You're doing fine.

oracle_ch1_converge_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_converge_01.text: {oracle} notices the deck in your hand. Their eyes widen slightly.

oracle_ch1_converge_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_converge_02.text: You have a deck. A real one -- not bought, not borrowed. Given. Decks like that are rare.

oracle_ch1_converge_03.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_converge_03.text: May I? Let's draw one card together. Just to see where you are. Not where you're going -- where you are right now.

oracle_ch1_first_draw.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_first_draw.text: You place the deck on the table between you. The top card seems to glow faintly in the warm light.

oracle_ch1_post_draw_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_post_draw_01.text: Hmm. That's an honest card. It doesn't flatter. But it doesn't lie, either.

oracle_ch1_post_draw_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_post_draw_02.text: The cards aren't fortune-telling. They're mirrors. They show you what you already know but haven't looked at yet.

choices.text: I'm not sure I want to look.
Can I learn to read them?

oracle_ch1_accept_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_accept_01.text: Good. Trust that feeling. It's yours -- nobody can take it from you.

oracle_ch1_fear_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_fear_01.text: That's okay. You don't have to. The cards are patient. They'll wait until you're ready.

oracle_ch1_skill_02.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_skill_02.text:
[Skill Unlocked: Window of Tolerance]
Your window of tolerance is the zone where you can function and process things. When you're outside it, you're either in hyperarousal (panic, anger) or hypoarousal (numbness, shutdown). Learning to notice which zone you're in is the first step to getting back inside the window.

oracle_ch1_learn_01.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_learn_01.text: Yes. I'd like that very much, actually. It's been a while since I had someone to teach.

oracle_ch1_learn_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_learn_02.text: We'll start small. One card a day. No pressure, no tests. Just... listening.

oracle_ch1_evening_01.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_evening_01.text: The light in the sanctuary shifts. Golden hour. The kind of light that makes everything look like a painting.

oracle_ch1_evening_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_evening_02.text: There's a room for you here. Clean sheets, a window that opens onto the garden. It's yours for as long as you need it.

oracle_ch1_evening_03.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_evening_03.text: Tomorrow we'll explore more of this place. There are others here too. Good people. You'll meet them when you're ready.

choices.text: Thank you. This means more than you know.
Is it always this... gentle here?
I don't want to be alone tonight.

oracle_ch1_end_grateful.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_end_grateful.text: {oracle} reaches across the table and squeezes your hand. Brief, warm, intentional.

oracle_ch1_end_grateful_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_end_grateful_02.text: You don't need to thank me. You found this place because you were brave enough to need it. That's all you.

oracle_ch1_end_gentle.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_end_gentle.text: {oracle} pauses. Something flickers behind their eyes -- recognition. Like they understand exactly what you're asking.

oracle_ch1_end_gentle_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_end_gentle_02.text: Not always. But today, yes. And I promise you -- the days that aren't gentle, you won't face them alone.

oracle_ch1_skill_03.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_skill_03.text:
[Skill Unlocked: Safety Anchoring]
A safety anchor is a person, place, or object that helps you feel safe. When you're overwhelmed, bring your anchor to mind: picture it clearly, remember what it feels like, how it sounds. Your nervous system can learn to calm down when you connect with your anchor.

oracle_ch1_end_stay.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_end_stay.text: {oracle} looks at you for a long moment. Not with pity. Not with judgement. With understanding.

oracle_ch1_end_stay_02.speaker: oracle
oracle_ch1_end_stay_02.text: Then you won't be. I'll stay up, read by the fire. You can sleep right here. The couch is comfortable -- I should know, I fall asleep on it most nights.

oracle_ch1_end_stay_03.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_end_stay_03.text: You curl up on the couch. The fire crackles. {oracle} reads quietly nearby. For the first time in longer than you can remember, the tightness in your chest eases. Just a little. But enough.

oracle_ch1_end_shared.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_end_shared.text: Sleep comes. Softly, without violence. No nightmares tonight -- just darkness, warm and quiet, and the distant sound of pages turning.

oracle_ch1_end_final.speaker: narrator
oracle_ch1_end_final.text: In your hand, the deck rests. One card has risen to the top, face-down. It can wait until morning.
